To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
IL-1ra expression is reduced in dilatated cardiomyopathy.
the expression of IL-1ra is significantly lower in myocardial tissue of patients with dilated cardiomyopathies.
IL-1ra and IL-18 mRNA expression is reduced in myocardial tissues in patients with DCM compared with control tissues and patients with ICM.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of IL-1 and IL-1-related cytokines in myocardial tissue of adult and fetal human hearts and the potential role of this cytokine network in pathophysiological processes in human heart diseases.
the regulation and function of the cytokine IL-1 and its antagonist IL-1ra, as well as the related caspases and IL-18 in the human myocardium.
the role of IL-1 and IL-18 and their antagonists in the development of heart disease and with the potential use of these cytokines in diagnosis and therapy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IL-1ra is a potential target for therapeutic intervention in dilated cardiomyopathies.
the ratio of IL-18/IL-1β and IL-1β/IL-1α and IL-1α/IL-1-RA is altered in human DCM and ICM myocardium.
the IL-18 mRNA is lower in DCM and ICM patients compared to the controls and the IL-1ra is lower in DCD compared to the ICM and controls.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in DCM patients there is an altered ratio of the anti-inflammatory IL-1ra to the proinflammatory IL-1β in the myocardium.

the IL-18 mRNA expression is lower in myocardial tissues from DCM patients compared to ICM and control hearts and IL-1 receptor antagonist (IL-1ra) mRNA expression is lower than in ICM and control heart tissues.
the ratio IL-1ra/IL-1β is altered in DCM and that this ratio may contribute to pathophysiology of DCM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the expression of IL-1ra is reduced in DCM, but not in ICM.
IL-1α is not expressed in adult human myocardium but that IL-1β is.
the IL-18 mRNA is lower in DCM than in control tissues, whereas IL-1ra is lower in DCD than in control tissues.
